alibaba-open-code-review-open-code-revie.description: Review workspace changes, PRs, commits, or branch comparisons with OCR's native review pipeline and independently configured model provider. Produces line-level findings and explains the behavior and impact of committed changes by default. Fixes code only when requested. Use when the user wants native mode or has an OCR provider configured. To use the host agent's model without separate OCR credentials, choose open-code-review-delegate instead.
alibaba-open-code-review-open-code-revie.author: alibaba

alibaba-open-code-review-open-code-revie.description: Review workspace changes, PRs, commits, or branch comparisons with the host agent's model. OCR's CLI selects files and resolves rules; the host reviews them for defects and explains changes that affect users or callers. Use when the user has no separate API key for OCR or wants to reuse their coding-agent subscription or model setup. For OCR's full native pipeline with its own model provider, choose open-code-review instead.
alibaba-open-code-review-open-code-revie.author: alibaba
